clusters.name: Niche SEO directory playbook / portfolio
clusters.description: Build one or many niche directory sites that rank in organic search and earn passively from ads, affiliate links, paid listings or leads.

clusters.name: Local service-provider directory (listings/leads)
clusters.description: Directory of local service businesses in a niche that earns from featured listings, subscriptions or lead sales to providers.

clusters.name: Health, therapy and professional provider finder directory
clusters.description: Directory that helps people find doctors, therapists, rehab centres, vets or lawyers by insurance, price or responsiveness, paid by providers through placements or leads.

clusters.name: Pet cremation directory
clusters.description: Directory of pet and horse cremation facilities with calculators, earning from leads sold to vets and facilities or from ads.

clusters.name: Short-term rental vendor directories
clusters.description: Directories that help short-term rental hosts find courses, insurance, cleaners, linen services and property managers, earning from directory monetisation.

clusters.name: Wedding and event vendor directory
clusters.description: Long-tail directory of niche wedding and event vendors and venues, earning from vendor subscriptions, paid placement or commissions.

clusters.name: Restaurant and city dining directory
clusters.description: Restaurant guide or directory filtered by a niche attribute or city, earning from ads and sponsored listings.

clusters.name: Hobby and information niche directory (ads/affiliate)
clusters.description: Informational directory for a hobby or consumer niche that earns from display ads and affiliate links.

clusters.name: Directory as agency lead generation
clusters.description: Build a vertical directory, cold-email the listed businesses, and upsell them premium placement and agency retainers.

clusters.name: Developer and AI tool directory / launchpad
clusters.description: Directory or launchpad for developer tools or MCP servers, earning from sponsored listings or ads.

clusters.name: Niche job board
clusters.description: Job board populated by scraping listings, earning from paid employer postings or job-seeker subscriptions.

clusters.name: Personality-based job matching
clusters.description: Match employers and candidates through culture and personality quizzes, earning from placement fees or subscriptions.

clusters.name: Franchise discovery platform (Franzy)
clusters.description: Platform that helps prospective franchisees find and evaluate franchise opportunities, with advisory-based monetisation.

clusters.name: Home-service lead brokerage to subcontractors
clusters.description: Capture homeowner jobs online and dispatch or refer them to local subcontractors, keeping a margin, referral cut or lead fee.

clusters.name: Pickleball court and coach marketplace
clusters.description: Marketplace and app for booking private pickleball courts and tutors and coordinating play, earning booking margins.

clusters.name: Cleaning services marketplace
clusters.description: Uber-style marketplace that connects customers with cleaners and takes a commission.

clusters.name: Handyman mentor marketplace
clusters.description: App that matches young homeowners with retired tradespeople for DIY guidance and takes a commission.

clusters.name: Home-cooked meal marketplace
clusters.description: Marketplace where neighbours sell home-cooked meals to busy people, earning a commission.

clusters.name: Peer-to-peer used goods marketplace
clusters.description: Marketplace for buyers and sellers of used goods or textbooks, earning from marketplace fees and delivery.

clusters.name: Plastic-free goods marketplace
clusters.description: Marketplace for products that never touched plastic, earning a transaction spread or subscription.

clusters.name: Live-shopping marketplace (Whatnot)
clusters.description: Live-auction app for collectibles and other goods that takes about 10% of GMV.

clusters.name: Wholesale supply marketplace for live sellers
clusters.description: Marketplace that supplies inventory to live-shopping sellers and takes a commission.

clusters.name: Niche business-for-sale listing sites
clusters.description: Scrape business and commercial property listings into niche 'Zillow'-style sites for buyers.

clusters.name: Marketplace for closing businesses
clusters.description: Marketplace connecting owners about to shut down with buyers of their businesses or assets, earning fees.

clusters.name: AI agent persona marketplace
clusters.description: Exchange where creators sell deployable AI-agent personas to businesses and the platform takes a cut.

clusters.name: Pen-pal matching network
clusters.description: Pen-pal matching feature offered within a letter-subscription community.

clusters.name: Everything-home platform on blockchain
clusters.description: Home products, finance and services platform with home records stored on chain, earning from fees and commissions.

clusters.name: Airport lounge pay-per-access app
clusters.description: App that aggregates airport lounges for one-time paid access and earns a commission.

clusters.name: Software deal marketplace (AppSumo)
clusters.description: Sell discounted software deals to an email audience, earning a revenue share.

clusters.name: Local newsletter referral network
clusters.description: Referral engine in local newsletters that sells subscriber signups to local businesses on a per-lead basis.

clusters.name: Transparent backlink marketplace
clusters.description: Self-serve membership storefront that sells backlink placements at wholesale prices.

clusters.name: Neighbourhood home-services membership club
clusters.description: Annual membership that gives homeowners discounted group-booked home services, earning membership fees plus margin.

clusters.name: Certification and rating agency for software
clusters.description: Paid certification badge that rates SaaS or AI products as among the best in their category.

clusters.name: Care marketplace (Care.com)
clusters.description: Two-sided marketplace for childcare, senior care and pet care, earning from memberships and sponsored listings.
